info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Refinances-v4-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Refinement List API provides users with the capability to retrieve a comprehensive list of mortgage loans available for refinancing. This endpoint allows financial institutions and mortgage brokers to access detailed information on refinancing options, helping them offer tailored solutions to their clients. Typical consumers of this API include loan officers, refinancing specialists, and real estate professionals who need real-time data on loan products. Users can efficiently manage client inquiries and streamline the refinancing process by leveraging the data provided through this API.

get.description: Fetches the available refinancing options for loans, allowing users to explore potential financial benefits and adjust their loan agreements.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refinance operation on a loan. It requires specific details to process the request accurately and efficiently.

200.description: The refinancing information was retrieved successfully.
